copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用

copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 把 Teams 适配器从 channels 分支拷贝并注册到本地代码、装依赖、跑注册测试；再用 Teams CLI 注册 Entra 应用和机器人、把凭据写入 .env，并把机器人绑定到你指定的 Teams 账号。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目加 Microsoft Teams 频道时触发；若 .env 里已有 Teams 凭据，则跳过创建步骤直接重启。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Microsoft Teams 支持
say.note: 会拷贝并注册 Teams 适配器、装依赖、跑注册测试。

say.text: 现在开始创建 Teams 机器人
用 Entra 对象 ID 把助手绑到某个 Teams 用户
say.note: 绑定后由机器人先给该用户发消息。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Teams adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs the pinned package and runs the registration test. The Teams CLI creates the Entra app and bot, writes credentials to .env, and links the bot to a Teams account.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Microsoft Teams channel to a project. If .env already carries a Teams credential, the creation steps are skipped and it restarts.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams support to this project
say_en.note: Registers the Teams adapter, installs deps, runs the test.
Asks for a Microsoft 365 account and a public HTTPS tunnel.

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to a Teams user by Entra object ID
say_en.note: The bot messages that user first.
